_comment: Shared tool-arguments parity table for the two filesystem-sandbox ports (#197, D-014).
checkToolArgs, against the TS port's published TOOLS schemas) and by
jsonschema -- what the Python SDK runs before a call -- against the Python
port's published schemas). Sixth table, after the other five in this directory.
Before #197 the TS port enforced none of its published inputSchema: read_file
{path, max_bytes: 1} returned the WHOLE file, and {path: 5} was refused as
sandbox_escape (input_empty). The Python SDK refused both before the handler ran.
`fragment` is null for arguments both ports must accept, and otherwise a
substring both ports' refusal text must contain. Value rendering is left out
of the fragments on purpose -- Python prints True/None where JS prints
true/null -- so every row has exactly one schema violation and the fragment
names the rule, not the value.

cases.label: unknown property
cases.fragment: Additional properties are not allowed ('max_bytes' was unexpected)

cases.label: unknown property on write
cases.fragment: Additional properties are not allowed ('encoding' was unexpected)

cases.label: two unknown properties
cases.fragment: Additional properties are not allowed ('a', 'b' were unexpected)

cases.label: prototype name is not a declared property
cases.fragment: Additional properties are not allowed ('toString' was unexpected)
